title: ChirpStack v4 HTTP integration
description: ChirpStack v4's HTTP integration with JSON encoding. Uplinks (?event=up) become one record per device (DevEUI) with the decoded object's numeric keys as fields; location events move the device; other events are acknowledged and ignored; Protobuf encoding is refused (415). Private by default: trackers carry personal data.

params.name: lon
params.description: Station longitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

params.name: lat
params.description: Station latitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

setup.instructions:
In ChirpStack: Applications → (your application) → Integrations → **HTTP** → Add.

1. Payload encoding: **JSON**.
2. Event endpoint URL(s): `{url}`
3. Headers: `Authorization` = `Bearer {key}`.

ChirpStack appends `?event=up`, `?event=location`, … itself. Give the devices a codec that decodes to an object of numbers; at most 32 numeric keys become fields.
